notes.title: Patch v1057
notes.notes:
Starting experience update

  Increased first level bonus for ~20 features. Like Jump hole generator starts on sector 80. 
  Autobuy has 1/5 levels per purchase opened by default  (was 1 only)
  Spawn enemies mostly on screen
  Reworked starting money mechanic and updated stat description

  Beam platform can be hidden too now (not just laser)
  Fix gambler scaling
  Crit chance and crit damage stats on stats page


P.S. I don't post every small fix\update here. You can always see what was changed by small 1mb update ingame (click on label "rev XXXX" right to sector controls in top middle)
